Published sample notices of appraised value, used by `tests/test_real_notices.py`.
None of them belongs to a real owner (Tarrant's example uses "TAXPAYER, 1234 MAIN BLVD").

| File | Source | Correct reading |
|---|---|---|
| `tarrant_2025_example.png` | tad.org/my-appraisal-notice (2025 example notice) | 2025: 550,000; 2024: 460,000; Tarrant County |
| `fortbend_2024_letter.png` | fbcad.org "Anatomy of an Appraisal Notice" (value panel) | 2024: 189,581; Fort Bend County |
| `williamson_2026_blank.png` | wcad.org NOAV guide (empty value table) | no values: must not invent any |

Real owners' notices (e.g. a Harris County notice used during development) are
public records but carry a person's name and address, so they are never committed.
